decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software sits at the core of the firm's move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management. It survived the 2019 consolidation in which its sibling Product B was dropped, and with growing turnover and hiring providing slack, there is no performance shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

Flow measurement automation software is close to the firm's established offer and fits its strategic digital direction. It has had only a short time on the market, and the firm's growth and slack let it keep carrying the product while results remain uncertain rather than dropping it early.
